en:
I give up...
Why is this happening to us?
Why were we brought here?

I'm...not sure. They told us this was
a school, but I have my doubts.

Even if this *was* a school, it makes no
sense to have a bear robot for a headmaster.

Oops, I shouldn't say that. Keebo wouldn't
like me saying something bad about robots.
That is true...

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Robot<CLT=cltNORMAL>...I never could
have seen that coming. Guess anything goes.

Maybe my talent is something
really obscure too.

Rantaro, you still don't
remember your talent?
Yeah, it's a real pain...

Everyone else remembers their talent,
but why can't you remember yours?
Maybe...I don't want to remember.
Huh?

Maybe I was brought here unwillingly. Maybe it 
was a mistake and I don't really have a talent.
I mean, that's not impossible, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>It certainly isn't. I wasn't
exactly brought here "willingly" either...

<CLT=cltMIND>We're similar. I'm called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltMIND>
just because I happened to solve a case...
<CLT=cltMIND>Now that I think about it...

Hey, Rantaro. Maybe you don't remember
your specific talent...

but you do remember everything from
before you came here, right?

Yeah, I remember that stuff. I wouldn't
have been able to introduce myself otherwise.

Well then, tell me everything that you
remember. There may be a hint in there.
...Yeah...you're right!

I can't believe I didn't think of that. I
guess I'm more shaken up than I thought.

Uh, where to begin... If I started at
my childhood, this will take forever.

How about your favorite things?
Perhaps your hobbies?

People become <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL> by devoting themselves
to their hobbies and honing their skills.
Then I'd have to say...traveling.
Traveling?

Traveling is my hobby. Actually, I
travel around the world by boat.

On a boat!
Whoa, that's amazing!

Haha, no no, I'm not the amazing one,
my dad is. I just freeload on his boat.
I'm...how do I put it...?

I guess you could say I'm a "rich kid."
My family is pretty wealthy.

I sorta take my parents' boat
and do whatever I want.

Oh man, I sound like
a spoiled brat, don't I?
No, not at all...

I'm just taken aback.
I've never met a "rich kid" before...

Well, I help out with the family business,
too. I look for trading partners while I travel.

Globetrotting like that, you make a
lot of connections, y'know?

Maybe you're something like the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Rich Kid<CLT=cltNORMAL> or <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Traveler<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Nah...neither of those sound right.

As far as rich kids go, there are plenty
of people out there who are richer.

And "traveler"...
I dunno, that sounds a bit too romantic for me.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Useless Older Brother<CLT=cltNORMAL>
sounds a lot more up my alley.

"Useless Older Brother"? What do you
mean? You have siblings, but—

Sorry, Shuichi, but I really
don't want to talk about it.
But...

Really, I'm sorry, I shouldn't have
even mentioned it. Forget it.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Rantaro's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro's smile somehow
seemed...pained.

<CLT=cltMIND>With the conversation stalled,
I returned to my room.
